sections.heading: Residential Property Condition Disclosure And Other Disclosure Forms
Residential Property Condition Disclosure Act Resource Guide
sections.text: Offers guidance on compliance with the Residential Property Condition Disclosure Act, including definitions, requirements, and best practices. Download Guide

sections.heading: Disclosure Statement Form (Appendix A)
sections.text: Provides required statutory disclosures about residential property condition as outlined in the Residential Property Condition Disclosure Act. Download Form

sections.heading: Disclaimer Statement Form (Appendix B)
sections.text: Allows a seller to disclaim knowledge of certain property conditions when permitted by law, while still meeting disclosure obligations. Download Form

sections.heading: Exemption Form
sections.text: Identifies situations in which a property is exempt from the standard disclosure requirements and documents the applicable exemption. Download Form

sections.heading: For Your Protection, Get a Home Inspection
sections.text: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development Federal Housing Administration flyer advising home buyers on the importance of obtaining a home inspection. Download Form

sections.heading: Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home Pamphlet (EPA Link)
sections.text: Provides federal guidance on identifying and preventing lead exposure in residential properties. Visit Site

sections.heading: Lead-Based Paint - Landlord Disclosure Form
sections.text: Documents required disclosures from landlords regarding known lead-based paint or hazards in rental properties built before 1978. Download Form

sections.heading: Lead-Based Paint - Seller Disclosure Form
sections.text: Documents required disclosures from sellers regarding known lead-based paint or hazards in residential properties built before 1978. Download Form

sections.heading: Lead-Based Paint - Residential Disclosure (EPA Link)
sections.text: Links to EPA’s federal disclosure materials required in lead-based paint compliance. Visit Site

sections.heading: Residential Lease Agreement
sections.text: Outlines terms for residential rental property agreement, including rent, occupancy rules, maintenance obligations, deposits, notices, and landlord–tenant rights. Download Form

sections.heading: Residential Lease Application
sections.text: Gathers applicant information for screening, including rental history, references, income, and background authorization. Download Form

sections.heading: Disclosure of Brokerage Services to Landlord or Tenant
sections.text: Discloses to landlords and tenants information regarding required brokerage services including brokerage relationships and broker’s duties owed to all parties. Download Form

sections.heading: Flood Notice Form (Notice to Tenant)
sections.text: Provides tenants with required notification about flood risks associated with the property when applicable. Download Form

sections.heading: Key/Re-Key Addendum
sections.text: Specifies requirements and fees related to keying, re-keying, lock changes, and security procedures for rental properties. Download Form

sections.heading: Landlord and Tenants "You Need to Know" Information Guide (11-2014)
sections.text: Provides landlords and tenants with important information regarding rights, responsibilities, and Oklahoma landlord–tenant laws. Download Form

sections.heading: Pet Addendum
sections.text: Defines terms for pet ownership in rental properties, including fees, restrictions, responsibilities, and damages. Download Form

sections.heading: Residential Lease Supplement
sections.text: Adds additional terms or clarifications to a residential lease agreement as negotiated. Download Form

sections.heading: Tenancy Guidelines
sections.text: Provides rules and expectations for tenants, supporting consistent management and compliance with lease terms. Download Form

sections.heading: Landlord and Tenant Act (Non-Residential/Residential)
sections.text: Provides the statutory text of the Oklahoma Landlord and Tenant Act for reference to licensees and consumers. Download Act

sections.heading: Text of HB3282 (Landlord and Tenant Act - Service Animals)
sections.text: Provides statutory information related to service animals and housing protections under HB3282. Download Act

sections.heading: Buyer Affidavit of Land or Mineral Ownership - Individuals (SB 212)
sections.text: Documents required owner citizenship requirements for individual buyers outlined in Oklahoma law. Download Form

sections.heading: Buyer Affidavit of Land or Mineral Ownership - Business or Trust (SB 212)
sections.text: Documents required owner citizenship requirements for businesses or trusts outlined in Oklahoma law. Download Form

sections.heading: Buyer Affidavit of Land or Mineral Ownership - Exempt Business or Trust (SB 212)
sections.text: Documents exemption eligibility regarding citizenship requirements for qualified businesses or trusts. Download Form

sections.heading: Non-Foreign Seller Affidavit
sections.text: Documents seller status for federal tax purposes related to FIRPTA. Download Form

sections.heading: Non-Foreign Seller Information Sheet
sections.text: Provides explanatory information on FIRPTA requirements and seller obligations. Download Form

sections.heading: Notice to Buyer - Signs and Risk of Deed Theft
sections.text: Warns buyers about potential deed theft risks and explains steps to verify legitimacy and protect ownership. Download Form

sections.heading: Notice of Homeowner's Cancellation of Wholesale Real Estate Purchase Contract
sections.text: Allows a homeowner to cancel certain wholesale real estate contracts within the allowed timeframe, documenting the cancellation for legal compliance. Download Form

sections.heading: Wire Fraud Advisory
sections.text: Alerts buyers and sellers to wire fraud risks and provides best practices for secure communication and fund transfers. Download Form

sections.heading: Property Data Form
sections.text: Collects detailed property information to assist with listing preparation, marketing, and transaction documentation. Download Form

sections.heading: Service Members Civil Relief Act
sections.text: The Oklahoma Uniform Contract of Sale of Real Estate (Residential Sale, effective 01-01-2025) and the Confirmation of Disclosures form outline the legally binding terms for a residential property sale, detailing buyer and seller obligations, financing contingencies, property condition disclosures, inspections, title evidence, closing processes, and dispute resolution, with provisions for earnest money, treatments, repairs, and compliance with Oklahoma laws. Visit Site

sections.heading: Good Faith Estimate Form
sections.text: Good Faith Estimate Form: The Good Faith Estimate Form ("GFE") has evolved into variations of a "Loan Estimate" and "Closing Disclosure" document. The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) no longer oversees the GFE, so we are providing the following links in an effort to assist you with this step.
